findings.issue: `GetPropertyIdentifierLocation` uses `as PropertyDeclarationSyntax`, which evaluates to null for source-declared record properties (whose syntax is `ParameterSyntax`). This causes valid diagnostics like `BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull` to be assigned `Location.None` and silently dropped by `ReportIfLocatedInCompilation`, violating the requirement not to drop safety-relevant diagnostics for user-controlled types and contradicting claim C10.
